## OAuth Authorization

Authenticates a user and returns a Bearer access token. This token must be included in the `Authorization` header when calling protected API endpoints.

### Request

**Method:** `POST`

**Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/oauth/authorization`

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | String | Yes | The API key assigned to your account. |
| `password` | String | Yes | The password associated with your API account. |

### Notes

- This API must be called before accessing any protected API endpoints.
    
- On successful authentication, a Bearer access token is returned.
    
- Include the returned token in the `Authorization` header when making subsequent API requests using the format `Bearer` .
    
- If the provided credentials are invalid, the API returns an authentication error.

request.description:
## Get Entity List

Retrieves a list of entities added by a customer from Solr, filtered by year and organization. This endpoint is used by MO customers to fetch their entity list for a given year.

---

### Endpoint

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| **Method** | GET |
| **Base URL** | `{{BASE_URL}}` |
| **Path** | `/entity/getEntityListFrmSolr` |

---

### Authentication

This request requires a Bearer token passed via the `Authorization` header.

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `{{TOKEN}}` |

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `YEAR` | integer | Yes | The year for which the entity list is requested (e.g. `2026`). |
| `organization_id` | integer | Yes | The organization ID of the MO customer. |
| `maxResult` | integer | No | Limits the number of results returned (e.g. `10`). Defaults to all results if omitted. |

---

### Example Request

```
GET {{BASE_URL}}/entity/getEntityListFrmSolr?YEAR=2026&organization_id=13684
Authorization: {{TOKEN}}

 ```

---

### Response

On success, returns a list of entities belonging to the specified organization for the given year.

**Common response scenarios:**

| Scenario | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Success | Returns entity list for the given year and organization. |
| Invalid Organization ID | Returns an error if the `organization_id` is not valid or not accessible. |
| Access Denied | Returned when the token does not have permission to access the requested organization's data. |

---

### Notes

- Both `YEAR` and `organization_id` are **required** parameters. Requests without them may return an error or empty result.
    
- The `maxResult` parameter is optional and can be used to paginate or limit large result sets.

request.description:
## Create Entity

Creates a new entity. The entity is automatically created for all active years.

### Request

**Method:** `POST`

**Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/entity/create`

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entityName` | String | Yes | Name of the entity to be created. |
| `organization_id` | Integer | Yes | Organization identifier under which the entity will be created. Retrieve this value by calling the `user/getCustomerListFromSolr` API. |

### Validation Rules

- `entityName` must contain only supported characters.
    
- An entity with the same name must not already exist within the specified organization.
    
- Entity creation may be restricted based on the organization's subscription plan.
    

### Lookup APIs

| API Route | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| {{BASE_URL}}/user/getCustomerListFromSolr | `organization_id` |

request.description:
## Update Entity

Updates an existing entity. The updated entity information is automatically applied to all active years.

### Request

**Method:** `PATCH`

**Endpoint:** `{{BASE_URL}}/entity/update`

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entityName` | String | Yes | Updated name of the entity. |
| `id` | Integer | Yes | Unique identifier of the entity to be updated. Retrieve this value by calling the `{{BASE_URL}}/entity/getEntityListFrmSolr` API. |
| `organization_id` | Integer | Yes | Organization identifier to which the entity belongs. Retrieve this value by calling the `{{BASE_URL}}/user/getCustomerListFromSolr` API. |

### Validation Rules

- `entityName` must contain only supported characters.
    
- An entity with the same name must not already exist within the specified organization.
    
- The specified entity must be accessible to your account.
    

### Lookup APIs

| API Endpoint | Used For |
| --- | --- |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/entity/getEntityListFrmSolr` | `id` |
| `{{BASE_URL}}/user/getCustomerListFromSolr` | `organization_id` |

### Notes

- The updated entity information is automatically applied to all active years.
    
- Ensure the selected entity belongs to the specified organization before updating it.
